pages.title: Cutting a stencil
pages.text: Put an $(item)Unprepared Stencil$() in the left slot.$(br2)Pick what to cut in the panel on the right: the $(l)Stencils$() tab holds the 15 paint masks, the $(l)Glyphs$() tab the letters. The right slot previews it.$(br2)$(l)Cut$() makes it.

pages.title: Painting with it
pages.text: Right-click a block face with the stencil to lay it on, turned the way you face, like glazed terracotta. The block becomes a canvas.$(br2)Right-click again to turn it a quarter.$(br2)Paint over it with a loaded $(item)Paint Brush$(): only the holes take the colour.

Sneak-right-click with a stencil to lift it back. The pattern stays painted.$(br2)Lay another stencil and change colour to stack designs on the same face.$(br2)The $(item)Squeegee$() wipes a face clean and returns a stencil still lying on it.

pages.title: Glyphs
pages.text: A $(item)Glyph$() is a letter to stick on a wall. Hold one and aim at a wall: an outline shows where the letter will go, centred on the pixel you aim at.$(br2)Right-click to stick it, punch it to take it back. Line several up to write names and labels.
